"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is supporting investments in climate infrastructure that also help developing countries unlock economic growth in key areas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden convened two Summits for Democracy, bringing allies and partners together to strengthen democratic resilience.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden convened two Summits for Democracy to combat corruption.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden convened two Summits for Democracy to promote human rights globally, including for LGBTQI+ persons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The third Summit for Democracy occurred this year under South Korea's leadership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is proud to have catalyzed a new global forum to support and coordinate democracies around the world.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The new global forum to support and coordinate democracies around the world will continue in President Biden's second term.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
